name: denihida1216-site-build
description: Toolchain build untuk denihida1216.github.io (Tailwind + uji Playwright). Tidak disajikan ke publik.

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; (tail -f /dev/null | npm run watch) & npm run serve
scripts.build: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/input.css -o ../assets/css/site.css --minify && python3 scripts/make-id.py && python3 scripts/make-sw.py
